name: A Friend in Need
requirement: Find and free Dandelion.

name: All In
requirement: Play three hero cards in one round of gwent and win the match.

name: Armed and Dangerous
requirement: Find and equip all the elements of one set of witcher gear.

name: Ashes to Ashes
requirement: Complete the contract on Therazane.

name: Assassin of Kings
requirement: Take part in the assassination of King Radovid.

name: Bombardier
requirement: Collect the formulae for 6 different bomb types.

requirement: Read 30 books, journals or other documents.

requirement: Complete all fistfighting quests in Velen, Skellige and Novigrad.

requirement: Kill at least 5 opponents in under 10 seconds.

requirement: Kill 5 foes in a fight without taking damage (except for Toxicity) and without using the Quen Sign.

requirement: Kill 50 opponents using the environment (e.g. swamp gas, insects or objects).

requirement: Win all the horse races in the game.

requirement: Complete the contract on Sarasti.

requirement: Complete the contract on Morvudd.

requirement: Destroy 10 monster nests using bombs.

requirement: Defeat an opponent in a fistfight without taking any damage.

requirement: Complete the subplot involving Keira Metz.

name: Full Crew
requirement: Bring all possible allies to Kaer Morhen for the battle against the Hunt.

requirement: Complete all witcher contracts.

requirement: Discover 100 fast travel points.

requirement: Perform 10 effective counterattacks in a row without getting hit or parrying.

requirement: Complete the subplot about choosing Skellige's ruler.

requirement: Learn 12 potion formulae.

requirement: Find Yennefer of Vengerberg.

requirement: Reach character development level 35.

name: Mutant
requirement: Fill all mutagen slots.

requirement: Help Yennefer extract information from Skjall's body.

requirement: Finish the game on any difficulty.

requirement: Finish the game on the "Blood and Broken Bones!" or "Death March!" difficulty levels.

requirement: Complete the contract on the shrieker.

requirement: Find Ciri.

requirement: Ignite the gas produced by a Dragon's Dream bomb using a burning opponent. Do this 10 times.

requirement: Resolve the doppler problem in Novigrad.

name: The Enemy of My Enemy
requirement: Use the Axii Sign to force one opponent to kill another. Do this 20 times.

name: The King is Dead
requirement: Defeat Eredin.

name: The Limits of the Possible
requirement: Collect all trophies. Note: This is a PlayStation exclusive achievement.

requirement: Kill 3 opponents in one fight using 3 different methods (sword, bombs, crossbow, Signs, etc.)

name: Walked the Path
requirement: Finish the game on the "Death March!" difficulty level.

requirement: Attack, counter, cast a Sign and throw a bomb (in any order) in under 4 seconds.

requirement: Complete the contract on the Woodland Spirit.

requirement: Be under the influence of seven potions or decoctions at the same time.

requirement: Recreate all of Iris' nightmares in the Painted World.

requirement: Kill the prince cursed into a toad.

name: Let the Good Times Roll!
requirement: Participate in all the activities at the wedding.

name: Moo-rderer
requirement: Kill 20 cows.

name: Pacta Sunt Servanda
requirement: Finish the "Hearts of Stone" expansion.

requirement: Slide downhill uninterrupted for at least 10 seconds.

requirement: Kill 3 opponents with their own arrows.

name: Shopaholic
requirement: Buy all the items put on the block at the Borsodis' Auction House.

requirement: Unlock the bonus for equipping all the witcher gear elements from one School.

requirement: Be given Aerondight by the Lady of the Lake.

name: Hasta la Vista™
requirement: Kill a frozen opponent with a crossbow bolt.

name: I Have a Gwent Problem
requirement: Collect all the cards in the Skellige deck.

name: Kling of the Clink
requirement: Serve time in Toussaint.

name: Last Action Hero
requirement: Be decorated with the Order of Vitis Vinifera.

name: Playing House
requirement: Use all available options for developing Corvo Bianco.

name: The Grapes of Wrath Stomped
requirement: Help unite the warring vineyards and have wine named in your honor.

name: The Witcher's Gone South
requirement: Travel to the Duchy of Toussaint.

name: Turned Every Stone
requirement: Find all grandmaster diagrams for each witcher school.

name: Weapon "W"
requirement: Develop a mutation.
